name: Auto-review
summary: A second model reviews each risky action before it runs and approves, blocks or escalates it, replacing most human prompts. Shipped in Claude Code as auto mode and in Codex as auto-review.
how: The agent proposes a tool call
A separate reviewer model checks it against the user's request and a risk policy
Safe calls run; risky ones are blocked so the agent tries another way
Repeated blocks or critical risks fall back to the human
facts: Reviews only actions that already need approval; review failures fail closed
Extra model calls add tokens and latency
Far fewer prompts, but the reviewer can miss risk or block benign actions
goodFor: Long agent runs where constant prompts are impractical
A middle ground between manual approval and YOLO
watchOut: Anthropic says it reduces risk but doesn't eliminate it
Ambiguous intent or missing context can let risky actions through
